assumptions: The numbering scheme chosen; ANARCI's HMMs identify the domains and species.
limits: Numbering and germline assignment, not a structure or an affinity.
A germline identity is against the reference set we ship.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: The answer is the numbering, regions and germlines, which the outputs carry; the Antibody panel's sentence joins them with antibody_liabilities' count, so neither door alone holds that reading.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which antibody or TCR variable domains does this protein carry, how are they numbered, and which germlines are closest?

description: Find antibody and T-cell-receptor variable domains in a protein sequence, number them under IMGT, Kabat, Chothia, Martin, AHo or Wolfguy, call chain type and species, and assign the closest V and J germline with percent identity. Validated against ANARCI 2026.2.13.2 on every chain of its PDB benchmark.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

assignGermline.description: assign the closest V and J germline genes.

bitScoreThreshold.description: minimum HMMER bit score for a domain to count (ANARCI's default 80).

cdrDefinition.description: where CDR1-3 begin and end (abnumber's borders; North is read in Chothia numbering). Kabat, Chothia and North define H, K and L chains only; TCR domains keep IMGT's. Values: imgt (IMGT), kabat (Kabat), chothia (Chothia), north (North).

chainTypes.description: chain types to number: H, K, L (antibody); A, B, G, D (TCR). Others are still listed in the hit table.

protein.description: the protein sequence (one-letter amino acids); may hold several domains, e.g. an scFv.

scheme.description: numbering scheme. Values: imgt (IMGT), kabat (Kabat), chothia (Chothia), martin (Martin (enhanced Chothia)), aho (AHo), wolfguy (Wolfguy).

species.description: species whose HMMs are preferred for the hit and whose germlines are searched (ANARCI's default: human and mouse).

name: number_antibody

chainTypes.description: the chain type of each domain, in sequence order

domains.description: one entry per domain: chain type, species, sequence span, numbering as [position, residue] pairs, framework and CDR regions (0-based residue spans) under cdrDefinition, germlines

hits.description: every HMM hit over the threshold: id, E-value, bit score, start, end
